PLUGIN_PIN_VERDICTS.doc: What the qualification of the pinned bytes said: the value of a pin's verdict key. A pin with no verdict was learned on first use and carries no judgment. A word outside these is not a pin's.

inProcess.doc: qualified to run in a worker that other plugins share

isolated.doc: qualified to run, in a worker of its own

refused.doc: failed qualification: the pin records the bytes, a host should not load them

PLUGIN_PIN_POOLS.doc: Whether the plugin's qualification measured the CLAP thread pool real-time safe and faster at the quantum: the value of a pin's pool key. A plugin with no word runs serial. A word outside these is not a pin's.

cores.doc: its worker starts with the thread pool on, one helper per core of its cpu set but one, and no other plugin shares the worker

off.doc: measured, and not faster or not safe with the pool: the worker keeps no option

PLUGIN_PIN_KEYS.doc: The optional words of a pin, each this key, an equals sign and its value. Each appears at most once, in either order; a word with any other key is not a pin's.

verdict.doc: the qualification verdict of the pinned bytes, a word of PLUGIN_PIN_VERDICTS

pool.doc: the thread pool word of the pinned bytes, a word of PLUGIN_PIN_POOLS

PLUGIN_PIN_CHANGES.doc: What counts as changed: a pin holds the digests of the plugin's files and the fingerprint of its parameter layout, and only these two differ from it. Anything else about a plugin, its name or its version included, changes no pin.

files.doc: a pinned file is gone, or its bytes no longer have the digest the pin holds

layout.doc: the plugin's parameter layout no longer has the fingerprint the pin holds

PLUGIN_PIN_LAYOUT_FORMATS.doc: The formats the layout serialisation is written for, as the first line of its bytes names them.

clap.doc: every parameter clap.params gives, sorted by id

lv2.doc: every control port, sorted by index
